name: com.reromanlee.wireframes
description: Wireframe shapes that follow Transforms through GPU skinning: lines, polylines, boxes, circles, spheres, capsules, cones and more. Shapes are created once and cost no per-frame CPU work to animate, and every shape in a container is drawn with a single mesh.

samples.description: Every shape the package draws, laid out in rows and turning with their bones.
Spawns thousands of shapes on orbiting bones, to profile the package in your own project.
